malformedInput.method: Two sweeps: seven fixed cases and eight seeded body mutations each; the main loop remains alive after completion/rejection, then the harness terminates the process deliberately.

historicalProbeMetadata: The first spectator fault sweep predates per-variant command and installation-inventory fields. Its original fields are retained; the later player-state sweep includes both.

safety.input: Console commands only; no mouse or keyboard input injection.
safety.captures: Engine render-target screenshots only. TGA preview conversion preserves every pixel, checked against the source.

limitations: One stock map; short spectator and team/spawn sequences.
No combat, objective completion, whole match, multiplayer density, seeking, mod demo or dm_83 claim.
No listening or retail visual parity claim; broad ET compatibility remains open.
